name: Ramada by Wyndham Yongin
description: A comfortable and well-located 4-star hotel in Yongin, just 15 minutes from Everland — offering modern rooms, a pool, fitness centre and multiple dining options. The most popular and convenient international hotel for visitors to Everland with excellent transport links to Seoul.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Comfortable 4-star room with free WiFi, flat-screen TV and en-suite bathroom.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Spacious deluxe room with upgraded furnishings and city or park views.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Generous suite with separate living area and complimentary breakfast.

name: Golden Tulip Ever Yongin
description: A stylish hotel located within the Everland resort complex — offering themed rooms, direct access to the park facilities, multiple restaurants and the most convenient location for early park entry. The best on-site hotel experience for Everland visitors.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Themed room with park views, free WiFi and en-suite bathroom.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: Spacious family room sleeping up to 4 guests with park views.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Luxurious suite with panoramic park views and complimentary breakfast.

name: The Soom Forest Pension
description: A charming forest pension resort near Everland — offering beautifully decorated cabin-style rooms surrounded by Korean forest with barbecue facilities, outdoor spaces and a relaxed countryside atmosphere. The most unique and atmospheric accommodation option near Everland.

rooms.name: Standard Cabin
rooms.description: Cozy forest cabin room with free WiFi, private bathroom and forest views.

rooms.name: Family Cabin
rooms.description: Spacious family cabin sleeping up to 6 guests with BBQ facilities.

rooms.name: Premium Cabin
rooms.description: Upgraded premium cabin with separate living area and forest views.

name: Homebrige Cabin Hostel
description: A budget-friendly and cheerful hostel near Everland — offering clean dormitory and private rooms in a friendly social atmosphere. The best budget accommodation option for solo travellers and young visitors exploring Everland and the Yongin area.

rooms.name: Dormitory Bed
rooms.description: Clean dormitory bed with free WiFi and shared bathroom facilities.

rooms.name: Private Room
rooms.description: Clean private room with free WiFi and access to shared facilities.

rooms.name: Twin Room
rooms.description: Private twin room with two single beds and shared bathroom.
